test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

class_weights = torch.tensor(class_weights, dtype=torch.float32).to(device)

# Tokenizer with truncation
tokenizer = BertTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")

    )

val_encodings = tokenize(X_val)
test_encodings = tokenize(test_df["text"])

    def __getitem__(self, idx):

import torch.cuda.amp as amp

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(

    random_state=42,
)

# Tokenizer and model
tokenizer = BertTokenizer.from_pretrained("bert-base-uncased")
model = BertForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
    "bert-base-uncased", num_labels=3
).to(device)
model.gradient_checkpointing_enable()


# Dataset class with dynamic tokenization
class AuthorDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, texts, labels=None, max_length=128):
        self.texts = texts
        self.labels = labels
        self.max_length = max_length

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        text = self.texts[idx]
        encoding = tokenizer(
            text,
            max_length=self.max_length,
            padding="max_length",
            truncation=True,
            return_tensors="pt",
        )
        item = {k: v.squeeze(0) for k, v in encoding.items()}
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx])
        return item

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.texts)


# Create datasets

    for batch in tqdm(train_loader, desc=f"Epoch {epoch}"):
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "labels"}
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)

        with amp.autocast():
            outputs = model(**inputs)
            loss = loss_fn(outputs.logits, labels)

        scaler.scale(loss).backward()
        scaler.step(optimizer)
        scaler.update()

# Validation

with torch.no_grad():

import torch

from sklearn.metrics import log_loss

test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Encode labels
le = LabelEncoder()
train["author"] = le.fit_transform(train["author"])

X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train["text"],

    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=train["author"],
    random_state=42,
)

# Initialize tokenizer with shorter sequence length
tokenizer = DistilBertTokenizer.from_pretrained("distilbert-base-uncased")


def tokenize_data(texts, max_length=64):
    return tokenizer(
        texts.tolist(),
        padding="max_length",
        truncation=True,
        max_length=max_length,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )


# Create datasets
class AuthorDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, encodings, labels=None):
        self.encodings = encodings
        self.labels = labels

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {k: v[idx] for k, v in self.encodings.items()}
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx])
        return item

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.encodings["input_ids"])


# Prepare dataloaders with reduced batch size
batch_size = 8
train_encodings = tokenize_data(X_train)
val_encodings = tokenize_data(X_val)

val_dataset = AuthorDataset(val_encodings, y_val.values)

    train_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, pin_memory=True
)
val_loader = DataLoader(val_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=4)

# Initialize model
model = DistilBertForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
    "distilbert-base-uncased", num_labels=3
).to(device)
optimizer = AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-5)

# Training with gradient accumulation
grad_accum_steps = 2
model.train()
for epoch in range(3):
    total_loss = 0
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    for i, batch in enumerate(train_loader):
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items()}
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        loss = outputs.loss / grad_accum_steps
        loss.backward()

        if (i + 1) % grad_accum_steps == 0:
            optimizer.step()
            optimizer.zero_grad()

        total_loss += loss.item() * grad_accum_steps

    print(f"Epoch {epoch+1} Loss: {total_loss/len(train_loader):.4f}")

# Validation
model.eval()
val_probs, val_labels = [], []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in val_loader:
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "labels"}
        labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
        val_probs.append(probs.cpu())
        val_labels.append(labels.cpu())

val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()
val_labels = torch.cat(val_labels).numpy()
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {log_loss(val_labels, val_probs):.4f}")

# Clear memory
del model, optimizer, train_loader, val_loader, train_dataset, val_dataset
torch.cuda.empty_cache()

# Full training with all data
full_encodings = tokenize_data(train["text"])
full_dataset = AuthorDataset(full_encodings, train["author"].values)

)

model = DistilBertForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(

).to(device)
optimizer = AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=2e-5)

model.train()
for epoch in range(3):
    total_loss = 0
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    for i, batch in enumerate(full_loader):
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items()}
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        loss = outputs.loss / grad_accum_steps
        loss.backward()

        if (i + 1) % grad_accum_steps == 0:
            optimizer.step()
            optimizer.zero_grad()
        elif i == len(full_loader) - 1:  # Handle remaining gradients
            optimizer.step()
            optimizer.zero_grad()

        total_loss += loss.item() * grad_accum_steps

# Final predictions
test_encodings = tokenize_data(test["text"])
test_dataset = AuthorDataset(test_encodings)
test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=batch_size, num_workers=4)

model.eval()
test_probs = []
with torch.no_grad():
    for batch in test_loader:
        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items()}
        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
        test_probs.append(probs.cpu())

test_probs = torch.cat(test_probs).numpy()
submission = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=le.classes_)
submission.insert(0, "id", test["id"])
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

)

tokenizer = RobertaTokenizer.from_pretrained("roberta-base")


def tokenize_data(texts, max_length=128):
    return tokenizer(
        texts.tolist(),
        padding="max_length",
        truncation=True,
        max_length=max_length,
        return_tensors="pt",
    )


class AuthorDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, encodings, labels=None):
        self.encodings = encodings
        self.labels = labels

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {k: v[idx] for k, v in self.encodings.items()}
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx])
        return item

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.encodings["input_ids"])


batch_size = 8

val_encodings = tokenize_data(X_val)

    for i, batch in enumerate(train_loader):

        outputs = model(**inputs)
        loss = outputs.loss / grad_accum_steps
        loss.backward()

        if (i + 1) % grad_accum_steps == 0:

            optimizer.zero_grad()
        total_loss += loss.item() * grad_accum_steps

        inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in batch.items() if k != "labels"}

        outputs = model(**inputs)
        probs = torch.softmax(outputs.logits, dim=1)
        val_probs.append(probs.cpu())
        val_labels.append(labels.cpu())

val_probs = torch.cat(val_probs).numpy()

    train_df["author"].values,
    test_size=0.2,
    stratify=train_df["author"],
    random_state=42,
)

# Class weights for focal loss
author_counts = train_df["author"].value_counts().sort_index().values
total_samples = len(train_df)
alpha = torch.tensor([total_samples / (3 * count) for count in author_counts]).to(
    device
)
gamma = 2

# DeBERTa tokenization
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("microsoft/deberta-v3-base")
max_length = 256


def tokenize(texts):
    return tokenizer(
        texts.tolist(),
        max_length=max_length,
        padding="max_length",

    )


train_encodings = tokenize(X_train)
val_encodings = tokenize(X_val)

    def __init__(self, encodings, labels=None):

        self.labels = labels

val_dataset = AuthorDataset(val_encodings, [author_map[a] for a in y_val])
test_dataset = AuthorDataset(test_encodings)

test_loader = DataLoader(test_dataset, batch_size=16, num_workers=4)

)

        }

    input_ids = [torch.tensor(item["input_ids"]) for item in batch]
    attention_mask = [torch.tensor(item["attention_mask"]) for item in batch]

        input_ids, batch_first=True, padding_value=tokenizer.pad_token_id
    )
    attention_mask_padded = torch.nn.utils.rnn.pad_sequence(

        self.shuffle = shuffle

    def __iter__(self):
        if self.shuffle:
            indices = torch.randperm(len(self.data_source)).tolist()
        else:
            indices = list(range(len(self.data_source)))

le = LabelEncoder()

# Model config with correct number of labels
config = RobertaConfig.from_pretrained("roberta-base")
config.num_labels = 3  # Critical fix
config.hidden_dropout_prob = 0.2
config.attention_probs_dropout_prob = 0.2
model = RobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained("roberta-base", config=config)
model.cuda()

# Tokenizer
tokenizer = RobertaTokenizerFast.from_pretrained("roberta-base")

# Tokenize datasets
max_length = 128
train_encodings = tokenizer(
    train_texts.tolist(), truncation=True, padding=True, max_length=max_length
)
val_encodings = tokenizer(
    val_texts.tolist(), truncation=True, padding=True, max_length=max_length
)
test_encodings = tokenizer(
    test["text"].tolist(), truncation=True, padding=True, max_length=max_length
)


# Dataset class
class AuthorDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, encodings, labels=None):
        self.encodings = encodings
        self.labels = labels

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {k: torch.tensor(v[idx]) for k, v in self.encodings.items()}
        if self.labels is not None:
            item["labels"] = torch.tensor(self.labels[idx])
        return item

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.encodings["input_ids"])


# Create datasets and loaders
batch_size = 16

)

    optimizer, num_warmup_steps=int(0.1 * total_steps), num_training_steps=total_steps
)

        loss.backward()

        scheduler.step()
        total_loss += loss.item()
